theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 155: While you were on holiday, some thieves stole your wallet. You saw them, but they got away. Complete the description you gave to the police.

Bài 155: Khi bạn đi nghỉ, kẻ trộm lấy ví của bạn. Bạn thấy chúng nhưng chúng chạy thoát. Hoàn thành lời mô tả bạn khai với cảnh sát.

Exercise 156: Use the words in the first box to make true statements about the people in the second box.

Bài 156: Dùng từ trong khung thứ nhất để viết câu đúng về những người trong khung thứ hai.

Exercise 157: Complete the sentences using words from the box (a few (of), all (of), any (of), each (of), few (of), half (of), most (of), much (of), none (of)).

Bài 157: Hoàn thành câu bằng từ trong khung (a few (of), all (of), any (of), each (of), few (of), half (of), most (of), much (of), none (of)).

Exercise 158: There are mistakes in all these sentences. Correct the sentences.

Bài 158: Tất cả các câu này đều có lỗi. Hãy sửa lại.

Exercise 159: Choose the correct alternative (The place where I grew up).

Bài 159: Chọn phương án đúng (Nơi tôi lớn lên).

mcq.question: ___ them had fair hair.
mcq.full: All of them had fair hair.
mcq.vi: Tất cả bọn chúng đều tóc vàng.
mcq.expl:
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + singular verb (was).
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + động từ số ít (was).
Điểm ngữ pháp: all of + them.
mcq.key: ___ them had fair hair.|All of

mcq.question: ___ them was older than forty.
mcq.full: None of them was older than forty.
mcq.vi: Không ai trong số chúng quá bốn mươi tuổi.
mcq.expl:
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + singular verb (was).
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + động từ số ít (was).
Điểm ngữ pháp: none of + them.
mcq.key: ___ them was older than forty.|None of

mcq.question: ___ the men were wearing T-shirts.
mcq.full: Both the men were wearing T-shirts.
mcq.vi: Cả hai gã đàn ông đều mặc áo phông.
mcq.expl:
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + singular verb (was).
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + động từ số ít (was).
Điểm ngữ pháp: both (of) the + danh từ số nhiều.
mcq.key: ___ the men were wearing T-shirts.|Both

mcq.question: ___ the men had a shoulder bag.
mcq.full: One of the men had a shoulder bag.
mcq.vi: Một trong hai gã đeo túi đeo vai.
mcq.expl:
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + singular verb (was).
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + động từ số ít (was).
Điểm ngữ pháp: one of the + số nhiều.
mcq.key: ___ the men had a shoulder bag.|One of

mcq.question: Neither of the men ___ wearing a hat.
mcq.full: Neither of the men was wearing a hat.
mcq.vi: Không gã nào đội mũ.
mcq.expl:
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + singular verb (was).
all / none / one of them; both (of) the men; neither of the men + động từ số ít (was).
Điểm ngữ pháp: neither of + động từ số ít.
mcq.key: Neither of the men ___ wearing a hat.|was

mcq.question: It is widely believed that ___ human beings are descended from one common ancestor.
mcq.full: It is widely believed that all human beings are descended from one common ancestor.
mcq.vi: Nhiều người tin rằng tất cả loài người đều có chung một tổ tiên.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: all + danh từ số nhiều (nói chung).
mcq.key: It is widely believed that ___ human beings are descended from one common ancestor.|all

mcq.question: When Ellie decided to sell her car, she phoned round her family and her friends. But ___ them wanted to buy it.
mcq.full: When Ellie decided to sell her car, she phoned round her family and her friends. But none of them wanted to buy it.
mcq.vi: Khi Ellie quyết định bán xe, cô gọi cho gia đình và bạn bè. Nhưng không ai trong số họ muốn mua.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: none of + them.
mcq.key: When Ellie decided to sell her car, she phoned round her family and her friends. But ___ them wanted to buy it.|none of

mcq.question: Do ___ your colleagues give you birthday presents?
mcq.full: Do any of your colleagues give you birthday presents?
mcq.vi: Có ai trong số đồng nghiệp tặng quà sinh nhật bạn không?
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: any of + your (câu hỏi).
mcq.key: Do ___ your colleagues give you birthday presents?|any of

mcq.question: When my rich uncle died, he left ___ his fortune to his cat and the other half to a distant cousin!
mcq.full: When my rich uncle died, he left half of his fortune to his cat and the other half to a distant cousin!
mcq.vi: Khi ông chú giàu có qua đời, ông để lại một nửa gia tài cho con mèo và nửa kia cho một người họ hàng xa!
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: half (of) + his.
mcq.key: When my rich uncle died, he left ___ his fortune to his cat and the other half to a distant cousin!|half of

mcq.question: I think ___ children enjoy going to funfairs, although I know a few who are frightened of the big rides.
mcq.full: I think most children enjoy going to funfairs, although I know a few who are frightened of the big rides.
mcq.vi: Tôi nghĩ hầu hết trẻ con thích đi hội chợ, dù tôi biết vài đứa sợ trò lớn.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: most + danh từ (nói chung).
mcq.key: I think ___ children enjoy going to funfairs, although I know a few who are frightened of the big rides.|most

mcq.question: I think most children enjoy going to funfairs, although I know ___ who are frightened of the big rides.
mcq.full: I think most children enjoy going to funfairs, although I know a few who are frightened of the big rides.
mcq.vi: Tôi nghĩ hầu hết trẻ con thích đi hội chợ, dù tôi biết vài đứa sợ trò lớn.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: a few = một vài.
mcq.key: I think most children enjoy going to funfairs, although I know ___ who are frightened of the big rides.|a few

mcq.question: We’ll have to work quickly because I haven’t got ___ time.
mcq.full: We’ll have to work quickly because I haven’t got much time.
mcq.vi: Chúng ta phải làm nhanh vì tôi không có nhiều thời gian.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: much + danh từ không đếm được.
mcq.key: We’ll have to work quickly because I haven’t got ___ time.|much

mcq.question: Before mixing the cake, weigh ___ ingredient precisely.
mcq.full: Before mixing the cake, weigh each ingredient precisely.
mcq.vi: Trước khi trộn bột bánh, cân từng nguyên liệu thật chính xác.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: each + danh từ số ít.
mcq.key: Before mixing the cake, weigh ___ ingredient precisely.|each

mcq.question: I’ll have to buy a new tie. ___ the ones I’ve got matches this jacket.
mcq.full: I’ll have to buy a new tie. None of the ones I’ve got matches this jacket.
mcq.vi: Tôi phải mua cà vạt mới. Không chiếc nào tôi có hợp với áo khoác này.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: none of the + danh từ.
mcq.key: I’ll have to buy a new tie. ___ the ones I’ve got matches this jacket.|None of

mcq.question: ___ people enjoy housework, and I’m not one of them.
mcq.full: Few people enjoy housework, and I’m not one of them.
mcq.vi: Ít người thích việc nhà, và tôi không phải một trong số đó.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: few = không nhiều.
mcq.key: ___ people enjoy housework, and I’m not one of them.|Few

mcq.question: Brett lost his wallet, so he phoned ___ the shops he’d visited.
mcq.full: Brett lost his wallet, so he phoned all the shops he’d visited.
mcq.vi: Brett mất ví, nên anh gọi cho tất cả các cửa hàng đã ghé.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: all (of) the + số nhiều.
mcq.key: Brett lost his wallet, so he phoned ___ the shops he’d visited.|all

mcq.question: But he got the same answer from ___ place.
mcq.full: But he got the same answer from each place.
mcq.vi: Nhưng anh nhận cùng một câu trả lời từ mỗi nơi.
mcq.expl:
all / most / few + noun (in general); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (specific); much + uncountable; each + singular noun.
all / most / few + danh từ (nói chung); none / any / half / each of + the / my / them (cụ thể); much + không đếm được; each + danh từ số ít.
Điểm ngữ pháp: each + danh từ số ít.
mcq.key: But he got the same answer from ___ place.|each

mcq.question: He shouted at ___ students although most of us had done nothing wrong.
mcq.full: He shouted at all of the students although most of us had done nothing wrong.
mcq.vi: Anh ta quát tất cả học sinh dù hầu hết chúng tôi chẳng làm gì sai.
mcq.expl:
all of + the / them; none (pronoun) / no + noun; anybody + singular verb; few (= not many) vs a few (= some); all the information (not the whole + uncountable); any (= it doesn’t matter which); so much + uncountable; everybody knows; half of it.
all of + the / them; none (đại từ) / no + danh từ; anybody + động từ số ít; few (= không nhiều) khác a few (= một vài); all the information (không dùng the whole + không đếm được); any (= cái nào cũng được); so much + không đếm được; everybody knows; half of it.
Điểm ngữ pháp: all of + the.
mcq.key: He shouted at ___ students although most of us had done nothing wrong.|all of the

mcq.full: You can’t borrow money from me because I have none.
mcq.vi: Bạn không mượn tiền tôi được vì tôi chẳng có đồng nào.
mcq.expl:
all of + the / them; none (pronoun) / no + noun; anybody + singular verb; few (= not many) vs a few (= some); all the information (not the whole + uncountable); any (= it doesn’t matter which); so much + uncountable; everybody knows; half of it.
all of + the / them; none (đại từ) / no + danh từ; anybody + động từ số ít; few (= không nhiều) khác a few (= một vài); all the information (không dùng the whole + không đếm được); any (= cái nào cũng được); so much + không đếm được; everybody knows; half of it.
Điểm ngữ pháp: none (đại từ) / I haven’t got any.

mcq.question: What happens if anybody ___ left behind?
mcq.full: What happens if anybody gets left behind?

mcq.expl:
all of + the / them; none (pronoun) / no + noun; anybody + singular verb; few (= not many) vs a few (= some); all the information (not the whole + uncountable); any (= it doesn’t matter which); so much + uncountable; everybody knows; half of it.

mcq.full: What a boring town! There are no good clubs, nothing!

mcq.question: He was lonely because he had ___ friends.
mcq.full: He was lonely because he had few friends.
mcq.vi: Anh ấy cô đơn vì có ít bạn.
mcq.expl:
all of + the / them; none (pronoun) / no + noun; anybody + singular verb; few (= not many) vs a few (= some); all the information (not the whole + uncountable); any (= it doesn’t matter which); so much + uncountable; everybody knows; half of it.

mcq.full: I’ve wasted two hours because all the information you gave me was wrong.

mcq.question: I realised very quickly that although in many ways it appears unchanged, in reality hardly ___ is the same.
mcq.full: I realised very quickly that although in many ways it appears unchanged, in reality hardly anything is the same.
